thesis: PLMR is a high-quality P&C insurer with accelerating revenue (278.9M, 314.4M, 386.6M; YoY 58.0%). It is consolidating near its 52-week high (169.315) after the 11/05 earnings gap, with rs_63 +0.38, and earnings fall outside the window. Insurance sits outside the tech/semis-led selloff, which fits the provisional lesson favoring re-rated post-earnings names that hold near their highs. It is overbought (RSI 74, about 9% above SMA20), the regime is risk-off (0.93) and analyst upside is thin (mean target 172.0), so this is a pullback-only Overweight and not a Buy. Prices come unchanged from the technical card: entry is the 165.25 zone mid, with R/R 1.96 at mid and about 1.56 at the 167.0 zone top. At the 167.67 last price, R/R is only about 1.44, and at the 168.64 pre-market price about 1.28. Both are below 1.5, so do not chase above 167.0; treat it as Hold there.
